verdict.rationale: Render has no documented bulk-operation feature, but Blueprints let you define, deploy, and version an entire multi-service architecture from one YAML file. That gives a declarative way to change many resources at once, which a community member corroborates as infrastructure-as-code. A public REST API (OpenAPI spec confirmed) and the CLI could be scripted to loop over items, but nothing documents batch endpoints or multi-select actions. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch operations (e.g., bulk env var updates, bulk deletes or redeploys), documented batch API endpoints, bulk actions via MCP/CLI, and hands-on evidence of bulk workflows.
